facts.text: 通話とWhatsApp向けに、AIチャットボット、音声ボット、IVR（電話の自動案内）、キャンペーン管理を売る会社。運営法人はVoicetree Technologies。小売・医療・教育・不動産・金融などの営業・マーケ・サポート部門が客。
2013年3月、CEOのAnkit Jain（当時30歳）と弟で公認会計士のPrateek Jain（当時27歳）が開始。元手は兄弟の自己資金12ラック・ルピーで、主に技術とチームづくりに使った。2016年時点で外部資金はなし。Ankitは2010年に最初の音声サービスVoice Jadooを始めていた。
開始から6か月で登録利用者600人超、うち有料200社。客にはアーム・アードミ党、Lenskart、Snapdeal、Shop.IRCTCなどがいた。この間に損益が釣り合った（赤字を脱した）と説明している。
5人で始め、2016年には125人。このうち4割は直近6か月で採用した。従業員にはストックオプション（ESOP）で報いたと説明している。
2016年時点で登録利用者25,000人超、有料顧客2,000社超。新しい客にCanon、Fabindia、Cashkaro、DHLが加わったと説明している。
売り方はSaaSの年払い。他社との違いは、設定作業なしで通話管理を1分で立ち上げられる点だとAnkitは語る。
創業者が挙げた難所は、チームづくりと、市場でこの技術があまり知られていないこと。開始からの3年間は、市場への啓発と販売に力を割いたと語る。中小企業の技術利用はメール止まりだというのが本人の見方。
同じ記事は競合として、Exotel（2012年にシリーズAで2.5クロール・ルピー）、Knowlarity（2014年7月にSequoia CapitalなどからシリーズBで1,600万ドル）、Ozonetelを挙げる。MyOperatorはその間、外部資金なしで走ったと位置づけている。
現行の料金表は、Sedanが月5,000ルピー、SUVが月15,000ルピーで、どちらも10ユーザー。全プラン年払いで、GSTとMetaの料金は別。冒頭に30日間の全額返金を掲げる。
パートナー制度では、代理店が顧客向けの運用サービスの価格を決め、MyOperatorはパートナー用の基盤の費用を請求する形を示している。

Summarize with:
At a time when dark clouds are hovering over the startup ecosystem, with a dearth of high value funding and increasing shutdowns, is cloud telephony platform also suffering?Ankit Jain insists that it’s not. “ Cloud telephony is continuously growing and is in no way affected by the downturn in the startup ecosystem. With the growth in the sector, we are growing simultaneously,” quips Ankit (30), CEO and Co-founder of MyOperator.Launched in March 2013 by Ankit and Prateek Jain (27), MyOperator is a cloud-based call management system that provides solutions such as IVR service , virtual number , company number call , cloud EPABX, automatic call distribution, call tracking, recording and reports for business.Ankit is a graduate in computer science from BIT-Mesra University and has been following entrepreneurship for the past six years, ever since he launched his first platform, Voice Jadoo, in the year 2010. His brother Prateek is a chartered accountant.Ankit explains that the penetration of technology in SME business hasn’t gone beyond email. Now, lakhs of businesses require cloud telephony technology to organise themselves and get the maximum out of the market. He aims to offer the same to SME businesses.“Our growth figures throw light on the rising need for cloud technology across sectors and the thriving market opportunity for businesses like us,” says Ankit.
Growth story
Within six months of its launch, the startup had over 600 registered users, including 200 paying clients, the Aam Aadmi Party, Aamrapali O2, Lenskart, Snapdeal, Shop.IRCTC, Berger Emulsions, Allschoolstuff and Network Bulls among them. And during this time, the business broke even.Today, the platform claims to have over 25,000 registered users, with more than 2,000 paying clients. The new clients include the likes of Canon, Fabindia, Cashkaro and DHL.The team at the company has grown alongside the business. The platform, which started out with a five-member team, has grown to 125 people.“This growth largely happened in the last six months. Of 125 people, 40 percent were hired in that time,” says Ankit.On revenue growth, he says that MyOperator clocked a revenue of $2 million in the last financial year. He aims to double that in the financial year 2016-2017.“At a time when heavily funded startups like Flipkart, Zomato and Housing have laid off hundreds of employees and the whole ecosystem is going downhill, MyOperator, which has been successfully bootstrapped for the last three years, acknowledged the contribution of its employees in business growth by rewarding them with ESOPs,” says Ankit.[Tweet "Ankit Jain, the CEO, acknowledges the contribution of #employees by rewarding #ESOPs."]
Behind the scenes
Ankit and Prateek bootstrapped the platform with an initial investment of Rs 12 lakh, which was primarily spent on building the technology and team.“Building a capable and effective team was the biggest challenge we faced. More than experience, we tried to focus on the attitude of the team. Another issue we came across was the lack of awareness in the market about such technology,” says Ankit.He adds that in the past three years, the platform has tried very hard to raise the required awareness among businesses and sell the technology solution to them.When the Jain brothers launched the platform, there were other players in the cloud telephony market as well. They thought to differentiate themselves from their competitors..“Unlike its competitors, MyOperator enables businesses to set up a call management system within a minute, without going into any configuration. And this is how it also differentiates itself from other startups in the segment,” says Ankit.The platform follows a SaaS-based revenue model, where customers have to pay on yearly basis for using the service.
Competitive market
Though there are no track reports by research firms like Gartner or Frost & Sullivan available to assess the size of the sector in India, with about two million SMEs in the country, industry players estimate the domestic market size to be around $6 billion.In 2014, Exotel acquired Croak.it , a voice-based social media app. The company sees the move as a step closer to becoming a one-stop voice solution. In 2012, Exotel raised Rs 2.5 crore in Series A funding from Blume Ventures and Mumbai Angels in return for a 25 percent stake.In January 2014,Knowlarity acquired Unicom Techlabs, a startup in the same sector. Unicom had more than 200 customers, whom it handed over to Knowlarity along with all the intellectual property it had developed.In July 2014, Knowlarity raised $16 million in Series Bfunding from Sequoia Capital and Mayfield Advisors. Previously, in January 2012, it had raisedRs 34 crore from Sequoia Capital. The Gurgaon-based company has also received funding from Emergic Venture Capital in the past.In August 2014, Ozonetel acquired Yantra Software’s speech recognition vertical in a pay-out model. In February 2013, the company signed a strategic partnershipwith Resolvity Information Technologies in order to acquire the customers of Resolvity’s VoiceGain product.This article was originally published on YourStory .

Frequently Asked Questions
How are the three plans structured?
Sedan and SUV are our CPaaS plans — built for teams that want professional, reliable communication infrastructure on call and WhatsApp. Business AI Operator plan is a comprehensive plan that gives you CPaaS + AI Agents and a manager for your AI agents — for teams ready to deploy AI that actively runs their customer communication, managed end-to-end by MyOperator. Start where your business is; scale as it grows.
What does 'managed' mean in the AI plans?
It means a real person from MyOperator is accountable for your AI agents. They build them, deploy them, monitor performance, and continuously refine them as your business conversations evolve. You don't configure anything. We run the operation.
Why do AI agents need a manager?
AI agents aren't set-and-forget. Business conversations change — new queries, new flows, new edge cases emerge constantly. Without active monitoring and tuning, agent performance degrades over time. Think of it like any high-performing team: the output is only as good as the management behind it. Every Business AI Operator plan includes that management layer from our team.
What is AI Capacity and how is it different from the number of AI agents deployed?
AI Capacity is the total volume of AI work included in your plan — measured in credits consumed per voice minute, chat response, or workflow execution. The number of agents deployed, and the scope of each agent, is determined when we scope your AI team plan together. Your AI Capacity powers those agents and varies as per your plan. When the included Capacity is exhausted, additional usage is billed at the published credit rates.
Is the Business AI Operator replacing my human team?
No. Every AI Team plan in Business AI Operator is designed to extend your team's capacity — handling high-volume, repeatable conversations so your human agents can focus on complex, high-value interactions. The MyOperator AI Agent Manager works alongside your team, not instead of it.
Why is an AI plan more cost-effective than building a human team?
Building a team of sales or support agents with a dedicated manager is a significant commitment in salaries, training, and operational overhead — and that team only works business hours. Business AI Operator gives you an AI-powered team running 24/7, with a MyOperator manager already included, for a fraction of what traditional hiring would cost.
Is there a free trial?
Yes. We offer a short onboarding demo and a limited feature trial so you can experience MyOperator firsthand before committing. Our team can set up a sandbox account for you to test WhatsApp campaigns, call routing, or AI agents.
What happens if I cancel my plan?
You can cancel anytime. Your data remains secure for 30 days, allowing smooth reactivation or export.

facts.text: 通話とWhatsApp向けに、AIチャットボット、音声ボット、IVR（電話の自動案内）、キャンペーン管理を売る会社。運営法人はVoicetree Technologies。小売・医療・教育・不動産・金融などの営業・マーケ・サポート部門が客。
2013年3月、CEOのAnkit Jain（当時30歳）と弟で公認会計士のPrateek Jain（当時27歳）が開始。元手は兄弟の自己資金12ラック・ルピーで、主に技術とチームづくりに使った。2016年時点で外部資金はなし。Ankitは2010年に最初の音声サービスVoice Jadooを始めていた。
開始から6か月で登録利用者600人超、うち有料200社。客にはアーム・アードミ党、Lenskart、Snapdeal、Shop.IRCTCなどがいた。この間に損益が釣り合った（赤字を脱した）と説明している。
5人で始め、2016年には125人。このうち4割は直近6か月で採用した。従業員にはストックオプション（ESOP）で報いたと説明している。
2016年時点で登録利用者25,000人超、有料顧客2,000社超。新しい客にCanon、Fabindia、Cashkaro、DHLが加わったと説明している。
売り方はSaaSの年払い。他社との違いは、設定作業なしで通話管理を1分で立ち上げられる点だとAnkitは語る。
創業者が挙げた難所は、チームづくりと、市場でこの技術があまり知られていないこと。開始からの3年間は、市場への啓発と販売に力を割いたと語る。中小企業の技術利用はメール止まりだというのが本人の見方。
同じ記事は競合として、Exotel（2012年にシリーズAで2.5クロール・ルピー）、Knowlarity（2014年7月にSequoia CapitalなどからシリーズBで1,600万ドル）、Ozonetelを挙げる。MyOperatorはその間、外部資金なしで走ったと位置づけている。
現行の料金表は、Sedanが月5,000ルピー、SUVが月15,000ルピーで、どちらも10ユーザー。全プラン年払いで、GSTとMetaの料金は別。冒頭に30日間の全額返金を掲げる。
パートナー制度では、代理店が顧客向けの運用サービスの価格を決め、MyOperatorはパートナー用の基盤の費用を請求する形を示している。
